Here are today’s headlines – the latest news in the Philippines and around the world:

items: Sara Duterte’s ‘loose investments’ in Gencorp earn her P2.1-M ‘return of capital’

blocks.text: A defense witness says Vice President Sara Duterte has no business interests in Gencorp, but received more than P2 million in so-called ‘return of capital.’

items: DOJ starts process to extradite Apollo Quiboloy, others to US

blocks.text: The Philippine justice department starts the extradition process against doomsday sect leader Apollo Quiboloy, based on the request of the U.S. government.

items: US House blocks bid to impeach Defense Secretary Hegseth

blocks.text: Republicans in the U.S. House of Representatives succeed in blocking an effort to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, Tuesday, November 10.
